title: Lens: Integrations
summary: Send scan results into maps, records, terminals, tutorials, and route decisions.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Index and Wiki give scan results somewhere to link. TutorialCore can report Lens progress, and HoloMap can turn scan discoveries into route notes.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Lens with Wiki summaries, Index records, PowerGrid diagnostics, Reclamation crop checks, and WorldCore hazard preparation.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If scan sharing is unavailable, write down the finding or mark the place. The scan still has value when it changes what you do next.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
